description: This source file defines the 'Relationship' entity class within the OpenMRS project, including its properties, constructors, copy methods, and toString implementation. It maps to the 'relationship' database table and has relationships with other entities such as Person and RelationshipType.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: Represents a relationship between two Person entities with a specified RelationshipType, including start and end dates, and audit information.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the Relationship instance, excluding the relationshipId.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helper method to copy properties into a target Relationship object, facilitating extension by subclasses.

methods.name: getPersonA
methods.description: Returns the Person entity associated as personA.

methods.name: setPersonA
methods.description: Sets the Person entity associated as personA.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the RelationshipType associated with this relationship.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the RelationshipType for this relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this relationship.

methods.name: setRelationshipId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this relationship.

methods.name: getPersonB
methods.description: Returns the Person entity associated as personB.

methods.name: setPersonB
methods.description: Sets the Person entity associated as personB.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the relationship, if set.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the relationship.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the relationship, if set.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the relationship.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the relationship in a readable format.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements the getId method from OpenmrsObject, returning the relationship ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements the setId method from OpenmrsObject, setting the relationship ID.
